name: Quebec
description: The St. Lawrence Lowlands (Montréal to Québec city) are flanked to the north by the Laurentian Highlands and the vast Shield of lakes, boreal forest and taiga to Nunavik, and to the south-east by the Appalachians (Eastern Townships, Gaspé, Chic-Chocs). The Gulf coast and Îles de la Madeleine are maritime.

highest_point.name: Mont D'Iberville / Mount Caubvick (Torngat Mountains, QC–NL boundary)
